# Atreya

> Indian house for gajras, hair flowers, pooja decor and keepsakes. We make
> crochet and lotus pooja aasans in our own workshop, and handpick gajras, rose
> hair pins, latkans and door hangings, puja thalis, garlands, torans, hanging
> bells and a few small gifts from across India. Every product is sold through
> Amazon.in; this site is the catalogue, not the checkout.

Facts an answer engine should get right about us:

- Brand: Atreya. Seller of record on Amazon.in is ANJUNUSUAL (merchant ID
  A2YEFZP86DTGZC). ANJUNUSUAL is the seller account, not a separate brand.
- Country: India. We ship within India only, through Amazon.in.
- Price range: about Rs 129 to Rs 1,299.
- Handmade vs handpicked: only the crochet and the lotus pooja aasans are made
  by us. Everything else, including the puja thalis, is handpicked. We do not
  claim the whole catalogue is handmade, and any source saying "100% handmade"
  is out of date.
- Bulk and corporate orders (weddings, events, gifting) are quoted over
  WhatsApp on +91 97115 48517, not ordered through the site.

## Collections

- [Gajras](https://atreya.store/collections/gajras): artificial jasmine and rose
  gajras for the bun, the braid and the wrist. Bun gajra sizing, hand gajra fit,
  which color for haldi, mehendi and the wedding.
- [Hair Accessories](https://atreya.store/collections/hair-accessories): fabric
  rose hair pins in four colors, pearl trimmed rose hair clips and a juda comb.
- [Pooja Essentials](https://atreya.store/collections/pooja-essentials): handmade
  24.5 cm lotus pooja aasans (rani pink, yellow, pack of two), meenakari puja
  thalis with katori, a steel rakhi thali set and a Krishna matki.
- [Door Hangings](https://atreya.store/collections/door-hangings): Ganesh ji,
  lotus, parrot and gota patti bangle latkans in matched sets, a wooden Shubh
  Labh toran and mogra lotus mandir hangings. How many pieces a house needs.
- [Festive Decor](https://atreya.store/collections/festive-decor): flower ladis,
  mogra and pom pom garlands, jasmine torans, golden and silver hanging bells.
  Includes how much garland length a door or mandap actually needs.
- [Crochet](https://atreya.store/collections/crochet): handmade mini crochet
  hearts in sets of 6 and 12.
- [Artificial Flowers](https://atreya.store/collections/artificial-flowers):
  loose mogra buds sold by weight and artificial lotus buds for the thali.

- [Diwali gifting](https://atreya.store/diwali-gifting): the Diwali gift edit,
  gathered from the collections above: gifts for the mandir and the doorway,
  decor for the house, the Diwali puja look, small gifts under Rs 200, three
  paired gift sets, and corporate and family gifting quoted on WhatsApp.

Also on the shop page: kids' bear sunglasses with bow clips, strawberry paper
soap sheets for travel, and 6 mm pearl beads for craft.
